firm_data.firm_description: Lipsky Lowe LLP is a New York City employment law firm with over 40 years of experience focused exclusively on employment law, representing individuals, classes, and small businesses in all types of employment matters.
notable_facts: Prior to co-founding the firm, Doug Lipsky and Chris Lowe worked together at Seyfarth Shaw LLP.
Douglas Lipsky has been named a New York Magazine Super Lawyer every year since 2011.

email.subject: AI for Lipsky Lowe LLP, built for employment law
email.body:
Hi Douglas,

Since founding Lipsky Lowe in 2017, you've built a firm focused exclusively on employment law across individual, class, and small business matters. That specialization is exactly where AI creates the most leverage.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of specialized practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now expanding in New York. I'd be happy to stop by your office to show how we're helping employment law firms compete with larger competitors.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
